source: Tŷ Mawr reference photographs (4 Nov 2026: aerial from SE, house front, stables from the yard) and reference paintings + colourised historic aerial (5 Nov 2026: barn with stable range; house, forecourt and gate; aerial of the group). Layout corrected 5 Nov 2026 to the Executive's written corrections, which win over any reading of the images: house front faces south; stable range faces south with its front level with the house front (never further forward); the barn on the west side of the group faces west. Sizes scaled from the images, best guess.
axes: metres, x east, z south, origin = centre of the house main range, house front faces south (+z)

buildings.photo_ref: 1988 Cadw survey photograph of the farmhouse, 29 July 1988 (front from the south-east): eave c.4.2 m, open timber porch left of centre, 3 first-floor windows, red ridge tiles, east gable bare rubble, red-brick east chimney | run 3 (5 Nov 2026) measured from the photograph with a perspective scale (window 1.5 m tall): eave c.5.2 m (first-floor window heads 0.6 m below the eave, ground-floor heads c.3.4 m below), roof c.35 deg, WEST END HIPPED (east end gabled with the brick stack), centre stack c.0.9 m east of centre, windows unevenly spaced (upper at -3.05/-0.6/+2.7 m, blank wall over the east 2.5 m), west upper window smaller

buildings.hip_note: 3D model loop run 26 (9 Nov 2026, #467 pantile C4): east end hipped, as the painted reconstruction AR-0011 shows (the roof runs down to the eave at the far end; no gable wall above the eave); hip pitch estimated
buildings.front_note: run 13 (7 Nov 2026, #pantile issue): south front read from the painting AR-0011 (approach along the lane, from the east), checked against AR-0008: from the west, a small 4-pane window, a dark green boarded door in a deep reveal, a long blank stretch, a second narrower green door; the east part blank. x offsets corrected for the painting's foreshortening (far west end compressed), estimated

rooflights.note: run 13: roof light on the south slope near the west end, as in the Cadw survey photograph of the farmhouse (29 July 1988); position estimated

buildings.doors: run 12 (7 Nov 2026), read from the stable-range painting AR-0024 (south front, from the south), left to right: window, door, window, door, open bay with a door at its back, window, door; dark green boarded doors and 4-pane windows, square heads (AR-0004 shows arched heads and a different order: a painting conflict, AR-0024 followed as the one titled for this front); x offsets scaled to the 14 m range, estimated
